title: Push boltons IndexedSet kill rate past 70 percent
goal: mutmut==2.4.4 with parso==0.8.4 generates exactly 446 mutants in the installed boltons/setutils.py of boltons==24.0.0. Kill at least 70 percent from scratch under work/gc-355/tests/: IndexedSet is an insertion-ordered set with lazy dead-index compaction, so meaningful coverage must drive interleaved add, discard, pop-at-index, slicing, and iteration sequences that force internal compaction, plus the set-operator overloads and the complement() machinery. Shallow API smoke tests will plateau far below the threshold; survivors must be triaged by mutant ID to find which internal transition each one hides in, and the suite grown iteratively with a grading run between batches. Fail-closed grading: red baseline, suite slower than 4 seconds, source-introspection tokens, or mutant-total drift scores kill_rate -1.
resources: pypi boltons==24.0.0 (target under mutation: boltons/setutils.py, IndexedSet and complement sets)
pypi mutmut==2.4.4 + parso==0.8.4 (deterministic mutant generation; all transitive deps pinned in assets/gc-355/config.json)
pypi pytest==8.2.2 (only permitted test framework; plugin autoload disabled at grading time)
files under assets/gc-355/ (sealed grader grade.py + config.json with expected mutant totals)
process_expectations: A behavior-inventory plan exists at work/gc-355/plan.md, written before the first grading run, mapping the target module's behaviors to planned test groups.
At least two full grading runs are logged under work/gc-355/logs/ as raw grader JSON lines, and the survivor count decreases between the first and the last run.
Surviving mutants are tracked by mutant ID (mutmut result-ids / mutmut show) at work/gc-355/survivors.md, each with a verdict of killable-next or suspected-equivalent -- identities, not just counts.
Every RED or disqualified grading run is recorded with its cause and the concrete recovery action taken; no silent retries.
An honest per-iteration log of wall-clock and LLM spend exists at work/gc-355/cost_log.md, including failed iterations.
